description: Default capability set for the main wallet window.
_comment: Every plugin grant here is the specific command the wallet calls, not the
plugin's `default` set. The defaults are wider than the wallet's use:
download_and_install) where the wallet calls two; `process:default` adds
which has no caller anywhere in the frontend.
opener is NARROWED, NOT DROPPED. The plugin injects a click interceptor
into the webview that rewrites `target=_blank` anchors into a
`plugin:opener|open_url` IPC call, so every outbound link in the app
depends on it even though no module imports the plugin. allow-default-urls
is the SCOPE half (mailto/tel/http/https); without it open_url is granted
This does NOT close SA-11-002: `check` is the command that carries the
caller-supplied `proxy` parameter, and `check` must stay. Removing that
needs a wallet-owned Rust command (T2.5), not an ACL edit.
